title: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Medical Image Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.23794v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision foundation models (FMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in medical imaging. However, they encode information in abstract latent representations that clinicians cannot interrogate or verify. The goal of this study is to investigate Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for replacing opaque FM image representations with human-interpretable, sparse features. We train SAEs on embeddings from BiomedParse (biomedical) and DINOv3 (general-purpose) using 909,873 CT and MRI 2D image slices from the TotalSegmentator dataset. We find that learned sparse features: (a) reconstruct original embeddings with high fidelity (R2 up to 0.941) and recover up to 87.8% of downstream performance using only 10 features (99.4% dimensionality reduction), (b) preserve semantic fidelity in image retrieval tasks, (c) correspond to specific concepts that can be expressed in language using large language model (LLM)-based auto-interpretation. translated_title: 用于可解释医学图像表示学习的稀疏自编码器
translated_abstract: 视觉基础模型（FMs）在医学影像领域取得了最先进的性能。然而，它们以抽象的潜在表示形式编码信息，临床医生无法对其进行查询或验证。本研究的目标是探索稀疏自编码器（SAEs），用人类可解释的稀疏特征来替代不透明的基础模型图像表示。我们使用来自TotalSegmentator数据集的909,873张CT和MRI二维图像切片，在BiomedParse（生物医学领域）和DINOv3（通用领域）的嵌入上训练稀疏自编码器。我们发现，学习到的稀疏特征：(a) 能够高保真地重建原始嵌入（R2最高达0.941），并且仅使用10个特征即可恢复高达87.8%的下游性能（实现99.4%的降维）；(b) 在图像检索任务中保持了语义保真度；(c) 对应于可通过基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动解释方法用语言表达的具体概念；(d) …（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究利用稀疏自编码器将医学影像基础模型的不透明嵌入表示转化为人类可解释的稀疏特征，仅用10个特征即可保留87.8%的下游性能，并能通过大语言模型自动解释每个特征对应的具体医学概念。
en_tdlr: This study employs Sparse Autoencoders to convert opaque medical imaging foundation model embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features that retain up to 87.8% of downstream performance with only 10 features, while LLM-based auto-interpretation links each feature to specific expressible concepts.
